scope.method: six context-separated AGO role passes, cross-examination, adversarial red team, judgment, invariant verifier

accepted: KAOPU is the neutral semantic and metrology layer.
World Score is the recursive organization layer.
Wave-making is a typed operator family for continuous world generation and reconstruction.
Discrete identity, events, relations and evidence remain graph structures.
Conductors create transparent versioned Views without rewriting evidence identity.
Wenzhou is the first full regional score pilot.
Physics, chemistry and time compatibility require typed constraints and explicit validity.
rejected: Forcing every kind of knowledge into waves.
Treating a Current Best View as final truth.
Treating file count as independent observation count.
Treating timeline interpolation as historical fact.
nextGate: Bind the closed logic to one real Wenzhou score page with at least one continuous field, one discrete object, two independent observation roots, one unknown or conflict, one change, one view and one rollback pointer.
